newsitem.title: USA: NASA's top 10 reasons to bring space shuttle home.
newsitem.headline: NASA's top 10 reasons to bring space shuttle home.

text.p: Mission control on Monday offered the crew of the space shuttle Columbia some tongue-in-cheek reasons for the early end to their mission.
A list of the "top 10 reasons why we are really coming home early" was faxed to the astronauts in their morning mail.
Officially, a malfunctioning power generator was blamed for cutting short the planned 16-day mission and bringing it home on Tuesday. Among mission control's alternative explanations were:
-- Crew forgot to do their taxes before they left and tax day is approaching April 15.
-- Hale Bopp comet aliens got way too close for comfort.
-- 0.J. Simpson trial is over and CNN needs something to cover.
-- Crew left stove on back in Houston.
-- Need to be home to see soap opera "Friends" on Thursday.
